root_decision.why: The current cash-conversion argument already appears in dated public research; accessible operating forecasts do not reveal a distinctive near-term disappointment in our model. The central conditional horizon price gives weak price-only short economics, while realistic changes in mature economics and risk worsen them. Early repricing was previously used to make the submission concrete rather than established by new evidence.
root_decision.scope_of_conclusion: This does not prove price is efficient, a correction impossible, or that every scenario must support the recommendation. Exact consensus and guaranteed catalysts are not required by M37. It is a judgment about this specific proposed position and evidence.
root_decision.why_not_switch_long: Lower discount-rate and more productive operating cases are alternatives, not newly adopted most-likely forecasts. Central end2026 value remains44.07, below dated60.55reference; do not relabel an upside case to force LONG.
